facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya has spearheaded the draft National Addressing System Bill, 2025 and national addressing standards developed jointly with the Kenya Bureau of Standards, for a system meant to assign a verifiable address to every street, building and parcel of land.

Parliament's report quotes the Bill's sponsor contrasting Kenya's reliance on informal dropped-pin location sharing with the absence of a structured addressing system, and the committee chair says Kenya has lagged in implementing a reliable national address system.

note: Describes the Bill's governance dispute only; states no addressing system as in service, under way, nationwide, used or absent.
National Addressing System Bill and Policy are only named as lined up; no drafting or delivery stated.

facts.fact: Postmaster General John Tonui says Posta Kenya is developing a proposed National Digital Address Infrastructure combining postal data with geospatial mapping and verified digital addresses for banks, e-commerce firms and government agencies.

The National Addressing System Bill, 2025, is before the National Assembly's communication committee and stakeholders including the Ministry and the Communications Authority support it, with the Ministry also drafting a National Addressing System Policy.
Communications CS William Kabogo said the draft National Addressing System Standards, Policy and Bill are awaiting consideration in Parliament.
